title: pkg/services/ domain structure
answers: Where do I find a given domain's business logic?
body: pkg/services/ is Grafana's business-logic layer: ~100 top-level subdirectories, one per domain (dashboards, folder, ngalert, auth/authn/authz, datasources, user, org, accesscontrol, star, featuremgmt, sqlstore, ...). Each domain typically exposes interface(s) + models at the package root, with a concrete implementation in a sibling `service`/`impl` subpackage (e.g. dashboards + dashboards/service, star + star/starimpl). Size varies hugely: star is ~80 lines total; ngalert is effectively its own sub-monorepo with scheduler/state/notifier/provisioning/eval subpackages.
